description: This file defines a function wrapper 'HTMLPurifier' that provides a simplified way to purify HTML content using the HTML Purifier library within the VTiger CRM project. It includes a function that initializes and reuses an instance of 'HTMLPurifier' class for repeated purification tasks.

methods.name: HTMLPurifier
methods.description: A wrapper function for HTML Purifier that initializes a singleton 'HTMLPurifier' object and uses it to purify HTML content.
